g.text: One cross-attention head: a word's map is one column of the weight table, and a column can spill onto the other animal's patches

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: Left: the arithmetic by hand, with numbers small enough to check. Right: the same column in SDXL, from the Z2 smoke run ("an eagle and a fox", seed 6001).

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: the fox's patch, so p3's output

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: is mixed into the fox's patch.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: With "a cheetah and a cougar" the same arithmetic lets the cheetah column spill onto the cougar's

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: patches. That pair borrows parts on 7 of 8 seeds; Z2's attention overlap measures whether its columns overlap more.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b2430

g.text: On SDXL: 70 layers, 1,024 or 4,096 patches per layer, 77 slots per row

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: the finished picture these maps belong to. Each map: one column, upscaled to 128 × 128, summed

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: over the layers, then rescaled so its own minimum is 0 and maximum is 1. Outlines are traced

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: roughly from the picture's colours (they miss the eagle's white head and the fox's white chest).

g.text: Each patch's row sums to 1 over all 77 slots in every layer. Averaged over the canvas at step 3, one layer gives the eagle slot 16%,

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: the fox slot 21%, the end slot 8%, the 70 padding slots 29% together, and the start, "an", "and" and "a" the other 25%.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #1b2430

g.text: Each map is darkest on its own animal and still covers the other one, in both directions: the two-way spill the toy shows.
